newsitem.title: UK: Rape (canola) doesn't cause allegies - report.
newsitem.headline: Rape (canola) doesn't cause allegies - report.

text.p: Oilseed rape (canola), increasingly blamed for allergies such as hay fever, is innocent of the crime, British researchers reported on Tuesday.
A study showed that the allergies are probably caused by reactions to other pollens, the researchers at the Institute for Environment and Health at Leicester University said.
The report, commissioned by Britain's agriculture ministry, looked at several ways the bright-yellow crop, grown for its oil, could cause a reaction.

"These included the release of pollen and chemicals called volatile organic compounds, the pesticides associated with the crop and the presence of fungus growing on the plants," the institute said in a statement.
They found little evidence the rape could cause allergies, they said. "Indeed, many of the health problems blamed on oilseed rape may be caused by allergies to pollen from other plants," they said.
But they said enough people complained about rape (canola) fields to justify more research into the possible causes of their allergies.
